## `com.nextfit.exceptions`

| # | Class | Type | Role in the system |
|--:|---|---|---|
| 345 | `AiException` | Class | Raised when the artificial intelligence service cannot answer: there is no key, there is no internet, the service refused the request, or its answer could not be read. |
| 346 | `BusinessRuleException` | Class | Thrown when an operation violates a business rule of the gym, such as registering a member who already exists, charging a subscription that is still active, or assigning a routine to a member without an active membership. |
| 347 | `InvalidDataException` | Class | Thrown when an input value does not meet the expected format, range or type, such as a negative weight, a malformed email, or an empty text where content is required. |
| 348 | `NextFitException` | Abstract class | Abstract root of the NextFit exception hierarchy. |
| 349 | `PersistenceException` | Class | Thrown when an error occurs while reading from or writing to the system's storage (data files now, database later), such as a corrupted file, denied permission, or a full disk. |
| 350 | `ResourceNotFoundException` | Class | Thrown when a resource (member, trainer, routine, exercise, etc.) is looked up by its identifier and does not exist in the system. |
